articles.title: Teen Phenom Mirra Andreeva Captures First Grand Slam at French Open
articles.summary: At 19, Russia's Mirra Andreeva dominated qualifier Maja Chwalinska 6-3, 6-2 to win the French Open. She's the youngest women's champion since Monica Seles in 1992. Andreeva thanked herself for battling "demons" to reach the top.

articles.title: Teen Summer Jobs Are Vanishing—Here's Why That Matters
articles.summary: The 2026 summer job market is the worst for teens in decades, with 219,000 fewer employed than last May. Economists blame AI, inflation, and tariffs. Yet working teens like barista Mariella Silva, 19, say it builds crucial life skills.

articles.title: May Jobs Report Defies Gloom: 172,000 Added, But Who's Really Benefiting?
articles.summary: U.S. employers added 172,000 jobs in May, smashing forecasts of 110,000. Yet beneath the headline, underemployment rose and inflation continues to erode purchasing power for most Americans, according to KPMG chief economist Diane Swonk.
